### Rejoice with others!
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-july-12-2010-11634591.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 18:4
Points:
- Success and personal blessings can become spiritual pitfalls if pride or envy takes root.
- Though next in line for the throne, Jonathan harbored no resentment toward David's rising popularity.
- Jonathan willingly aligned himself with God's plans by transferring his royal robe, armor, and weapons to David.
- Christians are called to set self-interest aside and wholeheartedly celebrate the victories of others in God's family.

### A Kindred Spirit
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/a-kindred-spirit2
Passage: 1 Samuel 18:1-4
Points:
- God provides kindred-spirit friendships to help believers endure difficult valleys ahead.
- Genuine companions are generous and willing to share their most valued possessions without reluctance.
- Intimate friends serve each other unselfishly without keeping score or demanding reciprocity.
- A true friend offers loyal defense against criticism, even when standing up for others carries personal risk.
